title: The Hebrew calendar: twelve months with 7/17 and 10/1 circled
summary: A full Hebrew calendar of the twelve numbered months from Tishri to Elul in three columns, marking Sukkot, Chanukkah, Pesach (Passover) and Shavuot. The 17th of the 7th month (Nisan) is circled in gold and the 1st of the 10th month (Tamuz) is circled in blue.

text.text: 1 Tishri (Sukkot 15–22) · 2 Cheshvan · 3 Kislev (Chanukkah 25–30) · 4 Tevet · 5 Sh'vat · 6 Adar · 7 Nisan (Pesach / Passover 14–22; 17 circled in gold) · 8 Iyar · 9 Sivan (Shavuot 6–7) · 10 Tamuz (day 1 circled in blue) · 11 Av · 12 Elul

numbers.note: 17th day of the 7th month (Nisan), circled in gold
